grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, onion, cheddar, egg, mushrooms, butter, garlic and crème fraîche are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday, cheap item at any Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a tea towel and a frying pan, and the technique suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: The quantities suit four and the method is sound, though a cook will probably want more than a pinch of salt for 800g of potato.

honest_times.reason: Frying 800g of rösti in batches at 5 minutes a side means at least two or three 10-minute batches, plus 6 minutes for the mushrooms, all of it attended at the hob, so the printed 15 unattended cook minutes is well short and the real total runs far past a quick breakfast.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot potato rösti suits a February morning, and the potatoes are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and written in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potato, egg, cheese and mushrooms make a filling, real-food breakfast a family would happily eat again.
